title: 第5章 天地人三老第6章 三年
lines: 而之所以各族没有追责萧家，也是因为萧家族长拿出的证据。
证明了萧家三爷的命魂灯在几年前就熄灭了，
可是，为了不让众人知道萧家因失去萧家三爷而实力减弱，
因此才没有公之于众，至于如何证明，
他们拿出了萧家族谱，上面确实是如同萧家族长说得那样记载的。
众人知道，族谱是不会说谎的，因为任何家族都有着属于自己家族的族谱，
而族谱是神圣的，不容许有任何的亵渎！
而也正是因此，炎城之中的人们并不知晓的是，这位萧家三爷早已被人夺舍。
因此，在萧三爷说是拜访林家时，林家众人也没有觉得有什么不妥之处，
毕竟，萧家与林家平时也多有往来！
而萧三爷之所以来到林家，其实是觊觎林家的血脉，企图从中获取某种利益。
夜晚的林家灯火通明，林战伸手摸了摸自己的脊骨，
那里早已不是人骨，而是人老为他炼制一副脊骨。
他的脊骨已经被天地人三老拿去救林烬所用。
回想一年前……
林战离开林氏宗族抱着襁褓穿过最后一道空间裂隙时，
三枚青铜铃铛突然在桃林深处同时鸣响。
正在炼丹的天老猛然掀开炉盖，
丹炉里七颗星辰砂凝成的星轨竟组成凶星临门的卦象。
来得比预想早了十二年。
天老拂袖收起丹炉，鹤氅在晨光中泛起流云纹。
当他飘然落在禁地入口时，地老已经蹲在青石上用酒葫芦画着阵法推演，
人老则暴躁地敲打着淬火池边的玄铁砧。
先天道体？不对...
地老突然扔掉酒葫芦，布满星辉的眼瞳里倒映出林烬周身跳动的血色符文，
这小子体内有东西在吞食天地灵气！
林战闻言剧烈咳嗽，胸前的绷带渗出冰晶状血迹。
他单膝跪地将婴儿托举过头顶：
求三老救这孩子性命！
淬火池突然沸腾，人老抡起锻造锤猛击池壁：
带着你的灾星滚出去！
二十年前萧家丫头偷走往生镜，现在又送来个吃人的怪物！
锤头砸出的火星在空中凝成锁链形状，却在触及婴儿襁褓时诡异地弯折成环。
天老指尖弹出三枚玉简拦住暴怒的人老，
俯身凝视婴儿眉心的火焰纹：
content_en:
The reason why the various clans did not hold the Xiao family accountable was because of the evidence provided by the head of the Xiao family.
It proves that the life soul lamp of the third master of the Xiao family was extinguished a few years ago.
However, in order to prevent everyone from knowing that the Xiao family's strength has weakened due to the loss of the third master of the Xiao family,
Therefore, it was not made public. As for how to prove it,
They took out the Xiao family tree, and it was indeed recorded as the head of the Xiao family said.
Everyone knows that genealogy does not lie, because every family has its own genealogy.
Genealogy is sacred and no blasphemy is allowed!
And precisely because of this, what the people in Yancheng didn't know was that the third master of the Xiao family had already been taken away from him.
Therefore, when Mr. Xiao said he was visiting the Lin family, no one in the Lin family felt there was anything wrong.
After all, the Xiao family and the Lin family often interact with each other!
The reason why Mr. Xiao came to the Lin family was actually because he coveted the Lin family's bloodline and attempted to obtain some kind of benefit from it.
The Lin family home was brightly lit at night. Lin Zhan reached out and touched his spine.
There are no longer human bones there, but an old man refining a spine for him.
His spine has been used by the three elders of heaven and earth to save Lin Jin.
Thinking back to a year ago...
When Lin Zhan left the Lin clan and held his infant child through the last space rift,
Three bronze bells suddenly sounded simultaneously deep in the peach forest.
Tianlao, who was refining elixir, suddenly opened the furnace lid.
The star trails formed by the seven star sands in the alchemy furnace actually formed the hexagram of the evil star coming to the door.
It came twelve years earlier than expected.
Tianlao folded his sleeves and put away the alchemy furnace, and the crane's cloak showed flowing cloud patterns in the morning light.
When he landed at the entrance of the forbidden area, the old man was already squatting on the bluestone and drawing formations with a wine gourd to deduce.
The old man banged the black iron anvil beside the quenching pool angrily.
Innate Taoist body? Wrong...
Di Lao suddenly threw away the wine gourd, and his starry eyes reflected the beating blood runes around Lin Jin.
There is something inside this kid that is devouring the spiritual energy of heaven and earth!
Lin Zhan coughed violently when he heard this, and the bandage on his chest oozed blood like ice crystals.
He knelt on one knee and raised the baby above his head:
Please save this child's life!
The quenching pool suddenly boiled, and the old man picked up the forging hammer and slammed the wall of the pool:
Get out of here with your bane!
Twenty years ago, a girl from the Xiao family stole the Mirror of Rebirth, and now a man-eating monster has been sent to her!
The sparks struck by the hammer condensed into the shape of a chain in the air, but when they touched the baby's swaddling clothes, they strangely bent into a ring.
Three jade slips popped out from Tian Lao's fingertips to stop the furious Ren Lao.
Leaning down and staring at the flame pattern between the baby’s eyebrows:
